study type: Pre- and postnatal development study (enhanced design)
exposure: Onartuzumab administration (75/50 mg/kg or 100/100 mg/kg intravenously once weekly from gestation day (GD) 20 through GD 174)
outcome: Placental infarcts with hemorrhage (chorionic plate, chorionic villus, decidual plate)
Decreased cellularity of hepatocytes with dilated hepatic sinusoids
cohort: Twelve confirmed pregnant female cynomolgus monkeys per group.
finding: Onartuzumab administration to pregnant cynomolgus monkeys resulted in decreased gestation length, decreased birth weight, increased fetal and perinatal mortality, placental infarcts, and some evidence of developmental delay in surviving offspring.
followup_time: Postnatal observations for developmental delay and perinatal mortality, but a specific duration after birth is not stated.
